title: OverTheWire Bandit: Unix/Linux Foundations
summary: An OverTheWire wargame for absolute beginners, introducing Unix/Linux basics through a sequence of contained exercises. The official overview encourages reading documentation and learning command-line concepts before progressing to other wargames.
defensive_use: Build foundational command-line literacy in the designated training game. Record what each exercise teaches and the limits of the environment before relating those concepts to defensive administration or later web-security study.
prerequisites: The publisher describes Bandit as suitable for absolute beginners.

access.note: OverTheWire rules identify its hosted educational resources as free. Shell connections and game access were not tested.

published.note: Original publication is not stated on the reviewed page.

source_displayed.note: The website maintenance date is not a publication or revision date for this course.

freshness.note: Official overview and rules reviewed. The provider-linked website repository has a June 4, 2026 maintenance commit. This establishes website maintenance, not the last modification of every lesson. No exercises were run.

caveats: Use only the designated game environment within current provider rules; the listing grants no authorization for other systems.
Provider rules prohibit publishing game credentials and restrict redistribution of training materials. This record contains an original description only.
